t: WAI origin conversation: from context fatigue to cognitive infrastructure

content.what: The foundational conversation where WAI concepts emerged. Started from context-limit concern, evolved into architectural vision for persistent human-AI collaborative intelligence. Concepts: context monitoring, knowledge distillation, advisor ecosystem, idea telemetry, model routing, tone files.
content.meta_insight: AI collaboration produces streams of cognitive signals. If captured and evolved, they become persistent intelligence that improves both human thinking and AI systems over time.
content.origin_metaphor: Weaver of yarn — each conversation adds a strand; over time the strands form a coherent fabric of intelligence.

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Signal recording the origin conversation and conceptual foundation of WAI. Full artifact at ref path.
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: An instruction to build roadmap concepts. Those await user prioritization.
